hkMoveContextFactors.factor: 貨梯／升降機預約（service lift booking）
hkMoveContextFactors.detail: Managed buildings often require advance service-lift reservation and permitted moving hours; deposits may apply. CC Move Eastern District guide: large estates usually need management registration ≥1 week ahead.

Consumer Council 2024: among per-item firms, stair surcharge often 15–20% of total per floor (15–20 steps); one firm 30%. Company examples: Apple % bands by step count; PriceRight 30% per floor of moving fee; Star Express HKD30–100/item/floor; Speedy HKD50–200/large item/flight.

Mid-Levels / Peak-adjacent narrow roads and distant loading points drive push fees. Apple: ≥50m +20%, ≥200m +30%, platform lift HKD300. PriceRight: push % of fee; Island Mid-Levels narrow-road note. Star Express: HKD100–300 per ~50m push; transfer/height-limit needs assessment. East Asia online quote includes stairs/podium (excl. complex village roads); tunnel/parking separate.

Apple +20% Sunday/PH. PriceRight +HKD200 Sat/Sun/PH. East Asia weekend minimum HKD1800 vs weekday HKD1000. GoGoX Call Van Sunday/PH surcharges on published table. Consumer Council noted most surveyed firms did not charge weekend fee except one (+HKD200) in the per-item subset.

hkMoveContextFactors.factor: 北角／城市花園相關公開資料
hkMoveContextFactors.detail: CC Move Eastern District page lists 城市花園 among estates and notes North Point older buildings may have small lifts. Consumer Council 2024 example scenario: North Point 5-person household Saturday move → Mei Foo, quotes HKD3,818–12,162 across 20 firms (survey prices, not current quotes).

No mover published a Moorsom Road-specific fee. Public geography: Moorsom Road is Jardine's Lookout (Peak-adjacent), not Central Mid-Levels escalator corridor — expect narrow roads, possible distant parking, stair/push factors typical of Peak/Mid-Levels pages (FTC, Best Movers, Speedy Mid Level list).
